policy: Guest binaries are fetched into browser memory on Boot, checked against exact byte lengths and SHA-256, and never included in this static distribution. Image assembly code is Apache-2.0; guest components retain their package licenses.

sharedKernel.limitation: A modern userspace does not upgrade this historical kernel. No Kubernetes/container compatibility is asserted.

changes: Validate gzip/tar boundaries, header checksums, paths, and hard links; no extraction into the host filesystem.
Generate a deterministic TinyEMU file list and serve every original file from the verified archive in memory.
Install the application-owned /terrarium-init and /etc/inittab to boot a supervised interactive hvc0 shell without a full service manager.
The host runtime configures the selected VPC/subnet address and installs its application-owned webget helper before running user initialization.

rootfs.license: Per-package SPDX identifiers are retained in /lib/apk/db/installed; this is a collection, not one license.
rootfs.sourceAvailability: The installed APK database records package versions, licenses, source package names, and exact Alpine aports commits. Upstream APKBUILD recipes identify source archives and patches.

rootfs.license: Per-package copyright and license files are retained under /usr/share/doc/*/copyright; this is a collection, not one license.
rootfs.sourceAvailability: The pinned artifact repository contains package versions, Debian release metadata, debuerreotype metadata, and snapshot.debian.org source/archive references for the image build date.

bootUtilities.archive: Same verified official Alpine rootfs used by alpine-riscv64
bootUtilities.purpose: Supply a small init/mount implementation and ifconfig, route, ping, nslookup, nc, wget, and httpd applets. The Debian shell, glibc, GNU tools, package database, and apt are preserved.

commonVerifiedBehavior: Real RISC-V64 Linux kernel boot through the shipped TinyEmuRuntime and worker
Init scripts and observed exit status
Writable guest files and Unicode command I/O
Native DNS and HTTP on subnet 10.42.7.0/24 using gateway 10.42.7.1 for both modern profiles
webget uses the assigned gateway, not a hardcoded default subnet
